title: Toto language
extract: Toto is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken on the border of India and Bhutan by the Toto people. The Toto are an Indigenous community originating from Totopara, West Bengal along the border with Bhutan. It is also spoken in Subhapara, Dhunchipara, and Panchayatpara hillocks in Jalpaiguri district, West Bengal.
